description: Legitimate search engines useful for discovering browser games. Use operators like site:itch.io "html5 game" or site:itch.io browser game to narrow results. Verified September 2026.

engines.name: DuckDuckGo
engines.description: The privacy-first search engine that doesn't track you, with its own instant answers and !bang shortcuts.
engines.privacy: No search history profiling; anonymous queries.

engines.name: Brave Search
engines.description: An independent index built without Big Tech — now one of the largest genuine alternatives to Google and Bing.
engines.privacy: No user profiling; anonymous usage metrics only.
engines.pricing: Free (Premium tier removes ads in results)

engines.name: Startpage
engines.description: Google results, delivered anonymously — the original privacy proxy for web search.
engines.privacy: No logging of searches or IPs; Dutch/EU data protection.

engines.name: Mojeek
engines.description: The UK-built engine with its own crawler and index — genuinely independent since 2004, no user tracking.
engines.privacy: No tracking, no profiling; logs anonymized after 7 days.
features: Own index (no results rented from Google/Bing)

engines.name: SearXNG
engines.description: Open-source metasearch you can self-host or use via community instances — aggregates dozens of engines, tracks nothing.
engines.privacy: No cookies, no tracking; instance-dependent (check each instance's policy).
engines.searchTip: Instance list at searx.space; pick one near you.

engines.name: Ecosia
engines.description: The search engine that plants trees with its ad revenue — transparent, privacy-respecting and certified B Corp.
engines.privacy: Anonymized searches after 7 days; publishes financial reports.

engines.name: Qwant
engines.description: The European search engine headquartered in Paris with its own indexing layer and strict EU privacy rules.
engines.privacy: GDPR-compliant; no sale of personal data.

engines.name: Kagi
engines.description: The user-funded, ad-free search engine built for quality — no ads, no tracking, deeply customizable.
engines.type: Paid search (own ranking over multiple sources)
engines.privacy: No ads, no tracking; queries not linked to accounts.
engines.searchTip: Great for deep research when you want zero SEO spam.

engines.name: Marginalia Search
engines.description: A one-developer indie search engine that prioritizes non-commercial, old-school web pages — perfect for discovering hobbyist games.
engines.privacy: No tracking, no third-party data sharing, short IP retention.
engines.searchTip: Try: browser game -poki -crazygames for indie-web finds.

engines.name: Swisscows
engines.description: The Swiss family-friendly search engine: anonymous, data-safe and free, with family-safe filtering built in.
engines.privacy: Swiss data protection; no data storage, anonymous queries.

engines.name: Bing
engines.description: Microsoft's search engine — strong at finding game pages, wikis and news, with reward points and media search.
engines.privacy: Standard Microsoft data collection; configurable privacy dashboard.

engines.name: Google
engines.description: The largest index on the web — exhaustive coverage, advanced operators and instant game information panels.
engines.privacy: Extensive data collection; private alternatives listed above.
